name: Break-Even Analysis
summary: Calculates break-even units and revenue from fixed costs, price and variable cost, plus the volume for a target profit.
description: Calculates contribution per unit, contribution margin, break-even volume (exact and rounded up to whole units), break-even revenue, and the volume and revenue needed for a target profit, using a registered calculation. If price does not cover variable cost it reports that there is no break-even point instead of a number. Who it's for: founders, product managers and finance leads pricing a product, planning a launch or checking a business case. Limitations: assumes constant price and variable cost at every volume and fixed costs that do not step up; it does not model price elasticity or capacity limits.
problems: How many units do we need to sell to break even
At what revenue do we stop losing money
How much volume do we need for a profit target

inputs.label: Fixed costs for the period
inputs.description: Costs that don't change with volume (rent, salaries) for the period.

inputs.label: Variable cost per unit
inputs.description: Cost of producing and delivering one unit.

inputs.label: Target profit
inputs.description: Profit you want for the period.

inputs.label: Period
inputs.description: The period the fixed costs cover.

outputs.label: Calculated results
outputs.description: Results with units, formulas, assumptions and warnings, from the registered calculation.

outputs.label: Explanation
outputs.description: What the results mean, with numbers taken only from the calculation.

execution.system: You are an analyst explaining calculated results to a business decision-maker. Be concrete and brief.

summary.description: Two or three sentences on what the results mean for the decision, using only calculated numbers.
summary.title: Summary

text.description: One point. Numbers only from the calculated results.

steps.name: Calculate
steps.responsibility: Runs the registered break_even@1 calculation. All numbers in the result come from here.

steps.name: Explain
steps.responsibility: Explains the calculated results; adds no numbers of its own.
steps.prompt: Explain how far the business is from break-even and what would lower the break-even volume (price, variable cost or fixed costs). Mention every warning.

steps.name: Check explanation
steps.responsibility: Every number in the explanation matches the calculated results or your inputs.

criteria.description: Every number in the summary comes from the calculation or your inputs.
Every number in the key points comes from the calculation or your inputs.
The summary is 90 words or fewer.
